Showing infra-suspect failures — anomalous, node-attributable (a group that otherwise passes that day, including on another node).
Showing node-suspect failures — attributed to the node, or unexplained — without build-wide, test-level and shared-infrastructure failures.
The Infra-suspect failures column is the node-attributable subset of Test group failures — a group that otherwise passed that day, including on another node.
The Node-suspect failures column is the subset of Test group failures attributed to the node or unexplained — not build-wide, not failing on other nodes, not a shared-infrastructure event.
